newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine cen.bank cuts refinancing rate to 18 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine cen.bank cuts refinancing rate to 18 pct.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank cut its key refinancing rate to 18 percent from 21 percent, effective today, the bank's press secretary Dmitry Rikberg told a news conference.
The central bank last cut the rate on May 26 to 21 percent from 25 percent. Early last year the rate was 105 percent.
Central bank chief Viktor Yushchenko told journalists late last month that the bank would cut the rate in early July if forecasts that inflation would ease came true.
The statistics ministry says monthly inflation fell to 0.1 percent last month from 0.8 percent the previous month.
Inflation stood at 5.3 percent in the first six months of this year and 39.7 percent for the whole of last year.
